title: Whiplash
approach: Writing a_j = c_j ^ g turns one operation into a swap of g with c_i, so {a_1..a_n, 0} is an invariant multiset reachable in any permutation; n even forces g = xor(a) ^ xor(b) uniquely, and the rest is a multiset equality test.

techniques.label: bit-manipulation
techniques.why: the operation is XOR and the invariant is an xor

verified: cross-checked against exhaustive BFS over 65,792 (a,b) pairs — zero mismatches
